Know your diamond

Understand the 4Cs of a diamond

✦ ───── ✧ ───── ✦

The 4Cs — Cut, Colour, Clarity and Carat Weight — are the internationally recognised characteristics used to describe and assess a diamond. Each stone is unique, and the balance of these factors influences its appearance and value.

01 / CUT

Brilliance & fire

Cut refers to how well a diamond's proportions, symmetry and polish interact with light. It is a key contributor to sparkle.

02 / COLOUR

Subtle shades

For colourless diamonds, grading generally runs from D (colourless) through Z (light colour). Differences can be delicate.

03 / CLARITY

Natural character

Clarity describes the presence and visibility of internal inclusions and external blemishes, assessed under magnification.

04 / CARAT

Weight & proportion

Carat is a unit of weight, not a direct measurement of face-up size. Shape and proportions also affect how large a diamond appears.

For each available stone, request its grading report, measurements and any treatment or origin disclosures. A grading report is not a valuation or a guarantee of resale price.
